payload.title: Platform events pipeline (Kafka/Redpanda + memory/sqlite drivers)
payload.description: FRICK_PLATFORM_EVENTS_DRIVER is set in compose (sqlite/kafka) but the Rust platform-events pipeline is unported (inspect/platform-events is a stub). Port the pipeline + the memory/sqlite/kafka drivers (TS platform-events.conformance.ts defines the shared contract). KafkaJS -> a Rust kafka client.
